children: Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (NSE:RELIANCE) saw big intraday swings as Jio Platforms’ IPO lifted group value above ~Rs.30 lakh crore while Q2 results showed strong refining and cash, heavy capex in O2C/New Energy, retail margin stress, and mixed analyst views.
Previous Week Recap
Reliance Stock Swings, IPO Debut
: RELIANCE stock saw large intraday swings as Jio Platforms’ IPO debuted Oct 28, boosting group value above ~Rs.30 lakh crore while RIL lost ~Rs.51,700 crore in market value.
Cash, Net Debt Drop; Capex Focus
: RELIANCE reported cash ₹2.68 lakh crore and net debt ₹1,17,140 crore at quarter-end, down from ₹1.23 lakh crore; quarter capex ₹38,153 crore focused on O2C, New Energy and consumer.
Refining Core Earnings Up
: RELIANCE: Refining core earnings jumped 68% on record crude runs and strong refining margins despite regional crude disruptions and higher freight costs.
After-Hours Results, Board Meeting
: RELIANCE posted after-hours quarterly results. Traders awaited a positive market reaction. A board meeting is set for Oct 30, 2026 to consider standalone and consolidated Q2 and half-year results.
Nuvama Buy, O2C Gains; Shares Slip
: RELIANCE Q2: Nuvama keeps Buy with cut target, cites gains from solar, BESS, transmission and Jio listing dilution risk; Equirus sees O2C strength, retail weakness. Shares slipped on results.
Mutual Funds Buy RELIANCE GDR
: Mutual funds bought Rs 4,605 crore of Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (RELIANCE) in September 2026; total mutual fund holdings reached Rs 99,267 crore at month-end.
Premium Fuel Exports Rise
: RELIANCE boosted premium gasoline sales to Australia, Kenya and Tanzania and raised diesel and jet-fuel shipments to Mediterranean markets, citing supply disruptions as the reason.
Ad Headwinds; Sports Ad Gains
: RELIANCE reported ad headwinds from weak ad demand and a shift in linear TV revenue; sports ad revenue rose due to more cricket events, affecting the company’s results.
ACC PLI: 15 GWh Allocation
: RELIANCE was allotted 15 GWh under India’s 50 GWh ACC PLI scheme; by March 2026 it had installed 1 GWh and 14 GWh remained uninstalled, with similar delays among other recipients.
Retail Margin Slump; 7-Eleven Impairment
: RELIANCE: Retail core margin fell to 7.8% (down 120 bps YoY). Company booked a ₹1.08bn impairment on 7‑Eleven and continues opening outlets and expanding online grocery.
